profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a Software Engineer at Performance Software Corporation.  I love to use creativity wherever I can, which includes anything from making art during my off-time to developing software.  I am a well organized, detail oriented person with a friendly personality.  My goal in life is to build a career where I can use my creativity to its fullest while contributing something meaningful to society.

Python, bash scripting, C, C#, mysql, Java
VS code, Gitlab, DOORS, VirtualBox, Docker, DB Browser, Eclipse
Agile software development team sizes ranging from 2 to 20 members

positions.title: Workshop Facilitator
positions.description: As a workshop facilitator, I get to help fellow students learn concepts and material from their courses.  I currently have experience facilitating for the Discrete Math course.  By teaching the material, I've gained a deeper understanding of it, and by working with other students I've gained the experience and confidence to help and learn from others.

positions.title: Digital Marketing Intern - Developer
positions.description: I worked closely with the Digital Marketing team, where I gained some experience working with the html and css languages and maintaining and localizing the company's websites.  Also, my work at F5 was focused mainly on web automation, where I worked with the Selenium API and C#, and I wrote around 40 web automation tests for the Digital Marketing team. In addition, I researched and gave a presentation on the benefits and costs of automated testing.

positions.title: Crew Member
positions.description: I gained experience taking cash and orders, developed multi-tasking skills, developed experience working with costumers, and worked well in a high stress environment.  I also earned an employee of the month award for the month of June 2013.

volunteerExperiences.description: I volunteered during the summers.  During my time at the food bank, I've learned how to work with the community and I've had the chance to help out those in need.  During my first year I helped set up and distribute food and unload daily supplies.  During the last few years, I participated in data entry, with client check in, and updating client accounts.  I have also helped inventory school supplies for the back-pack program.
